# Muncheez - llms.txt
# AI & LLM Discovery File - https://muncheez.co.ke/llms.txt

## What is Muncheez?

Muncheez is a premium on-demand delivery platform based in Nairobi, Kenya. It connects customers with local restaurants, supermarkets, pharmacies, and specialty stores for fast, reliable delivery across the city.

## Core Value Proposition

- **Fast delivery** of food, groceries, pharmacy items, water, and flowers across Nairobi.
- **Multi-portal platform**: Customers order via web app; Merchants manage stores and menus; Riders manage deliveries; Admins oversee operations.
- **Merchant onboarding**: Restaurants and supermarkets apply online, submit compliance documents (KRA PIN, Business Permit), and are approved by the Muncheez Admin team before going live.
- **M-Pesa integrated payments**: Settlements to merchants via M-Pesa Buy Goods Till or Paybill.

## Key URLs

- Homepage: https://muncheez.co.ke/
- Browse Stores: https://muncheez.co.ke/stores

- Sitemap: https://muncheez.co.ke/sitemap.xml

## Site Architecture

```
/ (Landing Page)
├── /stores          - Customer store listing & browsing
├── /company/        - About, team, careers, investors, press
├── /merchant/       - Partner signup, login, onboarding, dashboard (authenticated)
├── /rider/          - Courier signup, login, onboarding, dashboard (authenticated)
├── /admin/          - Admin console (restricted, approval-gated)
├── /terms           - Terms of Service
├── /privacy         - Privacy Policy
├── /cookies         - Cookie Policy
├── /contact         - Contact page
├── /help            - Help centre
└── /waitlist        - Waitlist signup
```

## Delivery Coverage

Nairobi, Kenya: Westlands, Kilimani, Lavington, CBD, Karen, Thika Road, Garden Estate, and surrounding areas.

## Technology Stack

- **Frontend**: React (Vite), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- **Backend**: Supabase (PostgreSQL + Auth + Storage)
- **Payments**: M-Pesa (Safaricom) via B2C/Buy Goods/Paybill integration
- **Hosting**: Vercel / custom domain muncheez.co.ke

## Merchant Onboarding Process

1. Merchant applies at /merchant/signup
2. Email verification required
3. Onboarding form: store name, address, KRA PIN, business permit, M-Pesa till
4. Admin reviews documents and approves/rejects
5. Approved merchants access full store management dashboard
